snippet.title: Market is Fine - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the first official look at "Market is Fine"! As a solo indie developer, the biggest support you can give me is adding the game to your Steam Wishlist. 👇

🛒 Wishlist on Steam now: [Steam Linkini Buraya Yapıştır]

About the Game:
"Market is Fine", developed solo under Vortexon Studios, is an innovative market management simulation that puts local culture and current events at its core. What sets it apart is its dynamic "Event" system featuring over 150 unique scenarios. Depending on the language you choose, the game adapts to that specific region's absurdities, daily struggles, and tragicomic realities.

Instead of a standard management game, you'll be fighting to keep your store afloat while dealing with relatable, region-specific events and subtle satirical challenges!

Follow the development and stay updated:

Web: https://vortexonstudios.com/
Contact: vortexon@vortexonstudios.com

#MarketIsFine #IndieGame #SimulationGame #SoloDev #ManagementSim #VortexonStudios
